frozen_after: Outcome-blind development-only lexical audit of 11975 selected ECG studies
candidate_sensitivity: report_evidence_proxy; explicit retained sinus-normal assumption, not strict clinical reconstruction

strict_mapping.0: Explicit affirmative current normal ECG, no recognized abnormality, conflict, unresolved history or summary uncertainty
strict_mapping.1: Affirmative repolarization abnormality including ST-T/T wave change or flattening wording, or explicit BBB/LVH; digoxin effect only with a repolarization/ST-depression finding. No affirmative ST elevation or unresolved uncertainty/conflict
strict_mapping.2: Explicit significant current ST depression without recognized secondary context or comparison uncertainty; retain adapted depression-only rubric
strict_mapping.missing: Sinus-only reports, uncertain or conflicting statements, ungraded ST depression, ST elevation, unresolved historical findings, and outside-rubric findings remain missing

proxy_difference: Same evidence mapping, but permit sinus fallback only without active recognized abnormality, unresolved history or any uncertainty cue. This is explicitly not proof of a normal ECG
new_recognition: ST-T changes, ST and T wave changes, T wave changes and T-wave flattening; reuse frozen V5 negation/status/significance engine without mutating it
secondary_context: BBB or LVH evidence maps to 1, including accompanying ST depression. ST elevation and pacing remain unclassified; isolated drug mention does not establish ECG effect
test_role: Previously inspected exploratory test cohort; no new independent validation claim
risk_primary_for_isolating_ECG_effect: baseline; expanded_coded is prespecified factorial sensitivity, not selected using test performance
paired_comparison: Both full-case results and same-person intersections versus legacy logic_patch; never attribute across-cohort AUC difference solely to score improvement

sources.role: Original HEART ECG methods: normal, repolarization, BBB/LVH/digoxin effects and significant ST changes
Machine-generated reports and summary schema; unsynchronized acquisition clocks, not report availability
